source.title: Some Open Problems Related to Quantum Computing

trace.notes: Input normalized as the zbMATH document URL https://zbmath.org/2156284. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv and outputs/shards/open-problems-shard-0.csv identified the title as 'Some open problems related to quantum computing'. DBLP and the author's publication list corroborated the exact work as Mika Hirvensalo, 'Some Open Problems Related to Quantum Computing', Bull. EATCS 74:154-170 (2001), later appearing in Current Trends in Theoretical Computer Science: The Challenge of the New Century, Vol. 1, World Scientific (2004).

Access failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus metadata_only and local network_or_dns_failure. Direct browser fetches of the zbMATH record did not expose a readable record body, local curl failed with DNS resolution unavailable in the sandbox, and the zbMATH API entry point exposed only the terms gate through the available browser session. DBLP exposes bibliographic metadata for the exact Bull. EATCS item but marks it as having no documents available.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempted exact-title search, exact-title plus PDF, exact-title plus author, Bull. EATCS 74 archive searches, DBLP, the author's publication pages, EATCS archive/on-line issue pages, World Scientific/bookstore table-of-contents pages, and citation-bearing secondary papers. Rejected candidates because they were bibliographic metadata, table-of-contents pages, citation snippets, archive pages that do not cover the 2001 issue full text, unrelated works, or secondary papers citing the work. No readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source artifact containing the problem statements was recovered.
No document map was produced because no readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the technical problem statements was recovered.

Source adequacy gate failed. Extraction was not performed because resolver metadata, table-of-contents entries, publication lists, search snippets, citations, and related papers cannot serve as technical evidence for accepted questions.
Saved exact JSON payload to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-2156284.json and outputs/latest.json.
